title: Gelephu EV taxi drivers’ request for operation of charging station
reason: No public protest or gathering is reported. Both pages describe individual drivers’ service and loan concerns and a representative’s request for government action; the 12 EV taxis figure refers to vehicles, not people assembled.
notes: The Bhutan Live body explicitly credits BBSCL as the story origin. S001 and S002 are the same story and are not independent corroboration. No attendance, violence, arrests or state-response action in a protest is coded.

title: Druk Phuensum Tshogpa press release calling for ministerial reduction and government accountability
reason: BBS reports an opposition-party press release making a state-policy demand; no public gathering, march or rally is described.
notes: A demand directed at government is reported, but a statement/press release alone is not an executed public mass gathering; participants and attendance are not reported.

title: GCRPPB statement urging release of political prisoners
reason: BNN reports an organization statement urging the Bhutanese government and international institutions to secure release of political prisoners; no public gathering or in-person action is reported.
notes: The body links to a separate HRW report, which was not opened because its source restriction remains in force. The BNN page is an organization statement and does not establish continuity of February’s completed letter-writing campaign.
